key_idea: Find each shape of the picture among the pieces, and see which piece is left over.
steps: The picture has a big circle, a small circle, a triangle and a thin rectangle.
These match pieces A, C, B and D.
There is no square in the picture, so the square is not used.

choice_feedback.A: The big circle is used as the big round part.
choice_feedback.B: The triangle is used under the big circle.
choice_feedback.C: The small circle is used at the top right.
choice_feedback.D: The thin rectangle is used next to the triangle.
